populations.gamma: G~Gamma(shape=1,scale=1),X=G-1; mean0 variance1 skewness2 excesskurtosis6 support[-1,infinity)
populations.lognormal: v=2*sinh(asinh(1)/3),t=1+v^2,s=sqrt(log1p(v^2)),m=sqrt(t),d=sqrt(t)*v; X=(exp(sZ)-m)/d; v^3+3v=2; no rounded generation constants
populations.contract: theoretical standardization only, never force sample moments; infer arithmetic mean of X, not log mean; kurtosis/tails/support still differ, no isolated causal kurtosis claim
populations.moment_checks: deterministic public SciPy mvsk check for mean0/variance1/skewness2 absolute error<=1e-10, and matching excess kurtosis/support

randomness.independence: independent populations, never pair L/G by matching IDs; same-original percentile/BCa share one B4999 mean vector; originals plus their independent inner randomness are the population-repetition units
randomness.no_prefix: one B level; no prefix comparison or old-panel reuse

inference.definitions: unchanged ddof1 t, linear quantiles, half-tie z0, jackknife acceleration and prior BCa validity rules
inference.truth_separation: infer_single accepts original context/bootstrap means only; no population label/parameters/truth
inference.invalid: reason-labelled, no fallback/clipping/adaptive B; warnings tau=B*min(q,1-q)<10 retained without exclusion

metrics.independent_unit: original sample and its one independent bootstrap computation; R10000 per seed/N30000 per population; no sd/sqrt(N*B)
metrics.stability: K1: lower_sd/upper_sd/S/Ase/Apop are NA for ALL methods including t; do not fill zero
metrics.intervals: 99% original-level mean t intervals for descriptive summaries; no clipping outside rate bounds; zero variance makes decision bounds undefined

confirmation.design: independent Welch99% intervals, ddof1/Satterthwaite, each N30000
confirmation.rule: lo>.01 or hi<-.01: supported practical difference (direction); lo>-.01 and hi<.01: not_supported practical-difference hypothesis AND equivalence_supported for this metric/these fixed conditions; otherwise touching/straddling=>inconclusive
confirmation.invalid: any required missing/invalid original, nonfinite or SE0=>NA/inconclusive; conditional complete-case references never decide
confirmation.seeds: all 3 seed differences/99% descriptive intervals reported; NO seed direction gate
confirmation.scope: both metrics must individually support equivalence before saying both within1pp; no general moment sufficiency/causal/infinite-B claim
confirmation.multiplicity: 2 approximate99% intervals; Bonferroni sum noncoverage about<=2%, not exact finite-sample guarantee

descriptive.population_contrasts: all3methods C/T/width independent L-G Welch, allseed and pooled
descriptive.method_contrasts: all3 same-original method pairs C/T/width with paired original-level MCSE, allseed and pooled; descriptive only

invalid_policy.denominators: retain planned/observed/valid/invalid/missing counts; invalid never becomes noncoverage
invalid_policy.local_gate: other-method invalids do not poison complete BCa target; required invalid/missing gives mainNA
invalid_policy.conditional: conditional_ references with finite-count denominators only

storage.sample_hash: SHA256 of original little-endian float64 C-order bytes
storage.reason: uint8 codes indexing per-panel Unicode reason_labels, code0 empty-valid reason
storage.original_records: original_metrics.csv.gz, streaming 180000 rows, gzip mtime0; IDs join NPZ hashes, no repeated bootstrap arrays
storage.estimate_caveat: conservative allocation, not guaranteed compression; actual size guard stops without scientific resizing if unexpectedly exceeded
storage.audit_limit: saved samples/endpoints permit aggregate audit, not a complete reconstruction of all60000 bootstrap generation sequences; frozen code/fixtures cover RNG/resampling logic

execution.main: once only, no extra seeds/R/K/B or redraw on outcome/invalid/timeout
execution.smoke: sole separately authorized6cells,R2,K1,B99 in smoke namespace;12originals/12streams/1188resamples; no scientific selection
execution.outer_guard: run_matched_guarded.py starts one child; TERM295s/KILL298s/finish target299s; worker soft-stop294s and reserve cleanup, outer CLI externally timed
execution.correction: actual code bug only, at most one separately authorized attempt retaining old source/results/reason, cumulative mainwall<=600s
execution.stop: save completed panels plus observed partial panel/CSV records and diagnostics, no automatic scale changes
